# Breach Radar 0.3.2

A packaging fix. If you already have 0.3.1 running, nothing about the app
changes — but 0.3.1 could not be installed by anyone who downloaded it, so it
should not be passed on.

**Downloads open properly again.** The 0.3.1 bundle was signed before the
database CLI was copied into it, which invalidates the signature. That is
invisible on the machine that built the app — a local build carries no
quarantine flag, so macOS never checks — and fatal everywhere else: a
downloaded copy reports *"BreachRadar is damaged and can't be opened"*, which
right-click → Open cannot get past. The CLI is now copied in before signing,
and the build refuses to continue if the signature does not verify, so this
cannot ship again without someone noticing.

Downloading Breach Radar for the first time still shows the usual
*"unidentified developer"* prompt, because the app is signed ad-hoc rather than
with an Apple Developer ID. Right-click the app and choose **Open** to get past
that one; it is asked once, per machine.

Everything in 0.3.1 — per-contact claim codes, server-chosen subdomains, and
the move of your board to `~/.undercurrent/db/breachradar/` — is unchanged and
described in `NOTES-0.3.1.md`.
